question: Avocado Oil Mexico
markdown:
Mexico is a leading global producer of avocado oil
, utilizing premium A-grade Hass avocados primarily from regions like Michoacán. Mexican avocado oil features a high smoke point (around 260°C / 500°F), a buttery texture, and rich monounsaturated fats. Popular brands available include
⁠Sol Mexican Avocado Oil
and
⁠Avohass
